_help: Edit while the bot runs. The log itself is ~/.sera/message_log.db. on_delete: keep = a message deleted in Discord stays, marked deleted; remove = it is erased here too. on_edit: append = an edited message keeps its earlier wording and a search finds either; replace = the new text overwrites it. who_can_forget: owner = only the owner can erase messages with !history forget; author = people can erase their own. keep_days 0 = keep forever. max_days_back 0 = no limit on how far a search without dates can reach. auto_recall: when a message sounds like she should remember something, the matching old messages are put in her notes without her asking (auto_days_back, auto_max_results). image_keep_hours: pictures saved for the coding agent are deleted after this many hours (0 = never) and fetched again from Discord when needed; image_check_minutes: how often the check runs; image_delete_unrestorable: also delete pictures that could not be fetched again (a DM, or a message not in the log).
